pages.title: Schema Versioning
pages.text: Blueprint data uses $(bold)schema version 2$(): $(li)$(bold)v1$() (legacy): `Map<String, Long>` — resource ID → count (no NBT) $(li)$(bold)v2$() (current): `List<ResourceRequirement>` — id + count + optional NBT$(br2)Old v1 blueprints load with `null` NBT for all resources (any item of matching type accepted).

pages.title: NBT Path Notation
pages.text: Paths use dot notation with `$(italic)` for list wildcards:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)`roomCode`:$() `nbt.getString("roomCode")` $(li)$(bold)`BlockEntityTag.roomCode`:$() `nbt.getCompound("BlockEntityTag").getString("roomCode")` $(li)$(bold)`importerExporterRates.$().rates`:$() Each list element's `rates` sub-list $(li)$(bold)`Config.Upgrades.SpeedTier`:$() `nbt.getCompound("Config").getCompound("Upgrades").getInt("SpeedTier")`

pages.title: Performance
pages.text: $(li)NBT extraction is fast — tracking a few dozen fields has negligible cost $(li)Registry lookups are cached on first access $(li)Scanning runs asynchronously (doesn't freeze the server) $(li)Use `subset`/`list_subset` over `exact` where possible (more robust to unrelated NBT changes)

pages.title: Key Classes
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)`FabricatorBlockEntity`:$() GUI inventory, scan/print logic, resource validation $(li)$(bold)`PreFabBlueprintItem`:$() Blueprint item with tooltips and right-click display $(li)$(bold)`BlueprintData`:$() Data record for blueprint contents (schema v2) $(li)$(bold)`NbtRequirement`:$() Record with matching engine (exact, subset, list_subset, range) $(li)$(bold)`NbtRequirementRegistry`:$() Singleton — loads JSON from datapacks, provides lookups $(li)$(bold)`BlockScanner`:$() Async block scanning with NBT extraction $(li)$(bold)`InventoryScanner`:$() Async inventory scanning with NBT extraction $(li)$(bold)`BlueprintScanCache`:$() Caches scan results in PreFab NBT for instant re-scans$(br2)---
